newsitem.title: USA: Foremost says storm claims to cut Q4 net.
newsitem.headline: Foremost says storm claims to cut Q4 net.

text.p: Foremost Corp of America said Tuesday it expects about $6.5 million in claims from the severe winter storms that struck Washington, Oregon, and Northern California during the latter part of December.
These claims will reduce earnings in the fourth quarter of 1996 by about $0.44 per share, the company said in a statement.
Currently, 3,200 claims have been reported that involve damage from snow, ice, wind and flooding, the company said.
Foremost said it has set up storm claim centers in the areas affected and has sent adjusters from around the country to help serve customers with damage.

"Although these storms were severe and widespread, we expect to resolve the majority of our customers' claims within the next 30 days," said Richard Antonini, chairman and chief executive officer, in a statement.
Foremost offers property and casualty insurance, life, credit accident and health insurance mostly for owners of mobile homes and recreational vehicles and automobiles.
Shares of Foremost were trading unchanged at 57-1/4.
